sources.entry: APNGb - macOS app which assembles and disassembles animated png files.

summary.one_liner: APNGb is a macOS app that assembles PNG frames into animated PNG (APNG) files and splits APNG files back into individual PNG frames.
summary.what_it_does: The app builds animated PNGs from a series of PNG frames and disassembles an animated PNG into its component frames. Assembling includes optimization and compression options, such as inter-frame optimization using alpha-blend and dispose operations, and compression via zlib, 7zip, and Zopfli. Users can change the frame delay for all frames or selected frames, and set playback options. Disassembling parses the APNG chunks and decodes them into full-size 32 bpp frames. The README says it is built on APNG Assembler and APNG Disassembler by Max Stepin, and it supports macOS 10.11 and above.
use_cases: Create an animated PNG from a set of PNG images on a Mac
Extract individual PNG frames from an animated PNG
Reduce the file size of an animated PNG
Change the frame delay of an animation
Make a lossless alternative to an animated GIF
stack: APNG Assembler (by Max Stepin, zlib/libpng license)
APNG Disassembler (by Max Stepin, zlib/libpng license)
notable: Assembles and disassembles APNG files in one macOS app
Optimization includes alpha-blend and dispose operations, dirty transparency, and palette optimization
Compression options include zlib, 7zip, and Zopfli
caveats: The README does not describe installation steps beyond a download link
